description: Archive issues — put finished work on the shelf so boards and searches show what is still live. Nothing is deleted: an archived issue keeps its key, history and comments, search_issues finds it with `archived in (true, false)`, and unarchive_issues brings it back. Only issues in a done status may be archived, exactly as on the board; any other is refused and named with the state it stands in ("not in a done status: AN-7"), while the rest of the list is archived. Takes a full member of each issue's project; a paused or archived project refuses every write.
name: archive_issues
title: Archive issues
